structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of about 10 same-name "Effective Accelerationism" (e/acc) tokens launched within about 40 minutes. The rush was probably set off by a post from Beff Jezos: the linked X status is from beffjezos. This contract launched on a Meteora virtual curve, migrated right away, and trades on PumpSwap. It went up about 380% to an ATH near $468k, then fell to about $280k and was down about 30% in the last 5 minutes. Turnover is extreme ($5.2M volume on a $280k cap), and the sell count is out of proportion to the small number of unique sellers.

narrative.description: e/acc is the effective-accelerationism movement, and Beff Jezos is its figurehead. A fresh post from him is a real attention catalyst that sets off a ticker rush.
narrative.why_spreading: A well-known personality posted, so there was a rush of copycat deployments within minutes. Attention is spread across many contracts.

token_connection.why_this_token: It shares the name and ticker and links the same Beff Jezos status. Nothing shows he endorsed this contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 other e/acc contracts. The leaders are 3m7Bhp at about $990k and CbcyNo at about $797k; CbcyNo launched earlier and is the one the project's website field points to. 13vVSQ has $2M hourly volume, and GqmEdR is an older 2024 e/acc token.

authenticity.evidence: The topic has real pull: a Beff Jezos post and a burst of copycat tokens. The flow in this pool looks manufactured, though. It did $5.2M of volume on a $280k cap. About 2,600 sells came from only 58 unique sellers, against 812 unique buyers. GMGN tags 20 bundler wallets. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets, GMGN shows only 5 page visits, and there is no paid promotion.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X data I can't see whether any contract was endorsed. The linked X account's rename history belongs to the real personality, so the deployer probably just attached his link.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 100% of LP as unlocked on one market, plus few LP providers
One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply; it may be a curve/pool vault, since GMGN puts top-10 holders at about 5%, but I can't confirm that
20 bundler wallets; very few unique sellers relative to sell count
Price is about 40% off its ATH and falling fast
Liquidity and attention are split across 10+ same-ticker clones
The creator has closed their position

structured_output.counterargument: Beff Jezos is well known, and a tweet from him can push an e/acc coin to a multi-million-dollar cap. If traders settle on this contract, $280k is cheap next to siblings at $800k to $990k, and catching up would be about 3x. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0, and 812 unique buyers in 15 minutes is real breadth.
unknowns: Whether Beff Jezos or others endorsed any specific contract
Whether the current dump continues before entry

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; I used only the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat e/acc contract in a crowded ticker rush and is not the leader. It has already peaked and is dumping, the volume looks bot-driven, and part of its LP is unlocked. A 2x from here would need this clone to win the rush, which is unlikely. It is more likely to bleed out or be pulled.
